record.question: Who among the following has been jointly awarded Nobel Prize for Chemistry for the year 2009?
record.explanation: The 7 October 2009 Nobel announcement names Venkatraman Ramakrishnan jointly with Steitz and Yonath. Source Venktaraman is a visible spelling defect, not another laureate. Historical exam context: 2010-03-24 (full date printed on cover). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/chemistry/2009/press-release/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
